name: Magical☆Tale
source:
In this love simulation, you play as Lucian, a student at a magic school who's been transformed by a curse into younger form and must now attend classes with young girls. As you attend class, you'll get to know eight personable heroines.

[From [url=http://uk.ps2.gamespy.com/playstation-2/magical-tale-chiccha-na-mahouzukai/]GameSpy[/url]]
translation:
在这款爱情模拟游戏中，你扮演卢锡安，一名魔法学校的学生，被诅咒变成了年轻的形态，现在必须与年轻女孩一起上课。当你上课时，你会认识八位风度翩翩的女主角。

[来自[url=http://uk.ps2.gamespy.com/playstation-2/magical-tale-chiccha-na-mahouzukai/]GameSpy[/url]]
